title: tesla_flying_roadster_short
question: Would you buy a flying Tesla? Comment below

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: At a SpaceX site in Texas, the new *Roadster* climbed a giant curved ramp.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: It drove *upside down*, launched into the air, *flipped*, and landed on its wheels.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Fans underneath *suck it to the track*. SpaceX thrusters push it into the air.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Tesla also claims zero to 60 in *0.81 seconds*, though that's not independently verified.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Turns out the future does have *flying cars*, Musk posted.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Is it street legal? *Depends on your street*, he joked.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: But there's no price yet, no approval to fly on public roads, and production isn't expected before *2028*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Would you buy one? *Tell us in the comments*.
